_public_note: Public build manifest. Verbatim retail source strings are stored as SHA-256 digests (fields ending in _sha256); the builder recomputes them from the user's own ROM. Japanese text in this file is written by this project.
_note: Editorial decision of record for the US-added mission-item family: the mission item US retail added in slot 0x48 (words:content/570 name, fx_text/25/71 description). JP retail's aligned slot holds a real, shipped, non-placeholder item -- a time-magic tome that no JP mission requires -- so the JP bytes are not a translation of this object; this manifest is. Consumed and revalidated on every build by ffta_jp_us_added_items.py. Markup: {HEX} is a CTR_FUNC operand; every other character is text.
description: US-added item identity over a real JP slot (RC24 finding, ffta_us_added_item_identity_audit.py): the two records RC23 still ships as JP retail's unrelated same-slot item, localized from the US retail originals.
root_cause: Source transfer pairs a US record with the JP record at the same index and takes the JP record whenever it is non-empty and parseable. ffta_placeholder_transfer_audit.py (RC16) added a guard for JP *developer placeholders* (クエスト<n>, ダミー<n>, 予備<n>); it does not fire when the JP record is real shipped content, which is what the JP records aligned with words:content/570 and fx_text/25/71 are. The US build re-used mission item slot 0x48 for Stuffed Bear -- required by the US-added postgame mission 383 `Memories`, and by no JP mission -- so JP retail has no name for this object at all. Policy (Main docs/decisions.md, 2026-09-01): JP retail is the authority for player-visible wording of the objects it has; an object the JP build does not have is US-added content to be localized.
provenance: PROJECT_AUTHORED_TRANSLATION -- not ported from JP retail. JP retail contains no record for this item.
jp_same_slot_policy: The JP retail record this build replaces is NOT stored here. The builder reads it out of the user's own JP ROM, proves the base image still ships it token-for-token through the chain's glyph allocation, and proves it is not a developer placeholder -- which is what makes this a different failure class from the RC17 placeholder-transfer family.
lane: CHR_FULL for every written entry; every glyph is a native JP record the production font already carries (zero new glyphs, zero font or metadata writes)

width_policy.rule: per-family bound = the widest single rendered line among that family's own JP originals, measured with the JP font advance metadata
width_policy.words:content: <= 86 px (JP words:content/507 沿岸警備隊メダル); クマのぬいぐるみ is 82 px
width_policy.fx_text/25: <= 192 px per line and <= 2 lines on the prose page (JP fx_text/24 originals: 192 px is reached by entries 29 and 115). The line carrying {5103} is additionally measured with the reference expanded to ミュート (181 px), because the static token measurement scores a substitution control as zero.

control_policy.preserved: the {5103} character reference of the US original ({5103} = ミュート, the same reference RC17 used for words:quest/383 ミュートの記憶 and pages:quest/1/182)
control_policy.dropped: the English word space {52} and the mid-record page break {4F}{42} between the two US prose pages -- JP retail's own fx_text/24 records put the whole description on one two-line page, and that is the shape this leaf's renderer is given everywhere else
control_policy.retained_from_the_base_image: the trailing statistics page ({1D09}武器こうげき... {40}{42}) is NOT rewritten. The builder splices the new prose page onto the record's own remaining pages, so the statistics page stays byte-identical to the JP retail page RC23 already ships. The US original's four ratings are all `-`, and so are the retained page's, which the builder asserts.

terminology.Stuffed Bear: クマのぬいぐるみ -- the mission item list writes animals in katakana (ネズミのしっぽ, ウサギのしっぽ, チョコボの卵, パンサーの毛皮) and the rest in kana, so クマの + ぬいぐるみ is the register of its own family
terminology.Mewt: {5103} = ミュート (RC17 us_added_missions manifest, control_policy)
terminology.memories / memory: 記憶 (JP words:quest/179 うばわれた記憶; RC17 words:quest/383 ミュートの記憶)
terminology.left behind: 残していった (残 attested s_text/6/5; RC17 pages:quest/1/182 uses 残された for the same scene)
terminology.teddy bear: ぬいぐるみ -- the item name is printed directly above the description, so the second mention does not repeat クマの

entries.note: the keepsake mission 383 `Memories` asks for; ぬいぐるみ is the ordinary Japanese word for a stuffed toy and クマ follows the family's katakana animals

entries.japanese: {5103}が残していった記憶のかけら。{4D}母親がくれたぬいぐるみの中にあった。
entries.note: the prose page only; the builder keeps the record's own statistics page verbatim. Two lines like every JP fx_text/24 original. {5103} renders ミュート, so line 1 is 181 px when the reference is expanded.
